# Languages & Translations

Languages and Translations help FEED create client materials in the languages your pantry supports.

## What Languages Does

The Languages page controls which languages are available for translation.

Enable only the languages your team needs.

**IMPORTANT NOTE:** More languages can mean slower translation speeds and higher AI cost.

## What Translations Does

The Translations page shows translated text stored in FEED.

![Translations table with filter controls and translation records](/help-screenshots/translations-table.png)

Use it to:

- Review translations.
- Edit translated text.
- Retry failed translations.
- Find missing translations.
- Remove translations that are no longer needed.

## When To Enable A Language

Enable a language when staff need client-facing documents or shopping lists in that language.

After a language is enabled, FEED may need time to prepare translations for existing content.

## How To Find Missing Translations

The Find Missing Translations dialog scans FEED for translation gaps.

![Find Missing Translations dialog with scan explanation](/help-screenshots/translations-find-missing-dialog.png)

1. Open Translations.
2. Select Find Missing Translations.
3. Review what the utility finds.
4. Start the missing translation work if needed.

## When To Retry A Translation

Retry a translation when it failed or appears stuck.

If the same language fails more than once, check AI Configuration or **[contact the developer](https://github.com/MattGeiger/williamtemple-feed#contact "underline")** for help.

## Tip: Improving Translations

Translations are shared. If you improve a translation, everyone benefits from that correction.
